ShortDescription.Value: GeoJSON map overlay visualization tool for Cities: Skylines II.

Publish.LongDescription:
CityTimelineMod is a Cities: Skylines II mod that displays prepared GeoJSON map data directly in the game world as a visual overlay.
The mod is designed to help compare real-world geographic data with the Cities: Skylines II terrain and map layout. It can render prepared layers such as roads, paths, water lines, water areas, zoning polygons, and map boundary references.
Important: CityTimelineMod is a bundle loader and visualization tool. It does not include complete city bundles by default.
The mod does not download OpenStreetMap data, generate city bundles, or automatically install full map assets. Full bundles are external assets prepared outside the game.
A compatible bundle may contain: - GeoJSON layers - manifest files - bundle index data - heightmap PNG files - worldmap/reference PNG files
In-game HUD:
The HUD panel is enabled by default.
Controls: - Alt + H: open or close the HUD panel - Bundle list: shows compatible local bundles when a bundle index is configured - Select bundle: choose the bundle to load - Apply / Rebuild: rebuild the overlay with the selected bundle and current live values - Close: hide the HUD panel - Layer toggles: enable or disable roads, paths, water lines, water areas, zoning, and map bounds - Visual controls: adjust transparency, scale, position, rotation, and height offsets
Bundle workflow:
1. Open the HUD with Alt + H. 2. Select an available local bundle from the bundle list. 3. Use Apply / Rebuild to load the selected bundle overlay. 4. The mod displays the prepared GeoJSON layers in the game world.
Terrain and heightmap workflow:
A new Cities: Skylines II map starts with the terrain currently loaded in the editor. CityTimelineMod does not automatically replace or import terrain.
To use the real topography associated with a selected bundle, import the matching heightmap manually in the Cities: Skylines II Map Editor through the terrain / heightmap import tools.
The heightmap and worldmap files are external bundle assets. They must be created, downloaded, or prepared separately, then selected from the user’s local disk when using the CS2 editor import tools.
The mod helps align and visualize prepared real-world data, but it does not automatically import terrain, generate bundles, or include complete city packs by default.
Testing with real bundles:
To test CityTimelineMod with real prepared city bundles, download or clone the companion repository:
https://github.com/Giscolab/cs2-realmap-generator
This repository is used to prepare compatible local map bundles, including GeoJSON data and related map assets. The generated bundles are external to CityTimelineMod and must be placed on the user's local disk before they can be selected from the in-game HUD.
Current status:
This mod is a work-in-progress visualization and calibration tool. It does not replace the road-building, zoning, water, terrain, or map-generation systems of the game.
WORK IN PROGRESS
